summary: Recent updates to Firefox's WebRTC (the technology behind video calls) have focused on improving the handling of audio data and keyframe statistics. The AudioPacketizer now returns a result status, which helps ensure that the calculation of audio sample counts is correctly safeguarded, improving the reliability of sound in calls. Additionally, new serialization for keyframe statistics means that details about video performance can be more effectively communicated, helping developers optimize video quality in real-time communications. These changes matter because they enhance the overall performance and reliability of voice and video calls, contributing to a better user experience during online interactions.
